followup_explanation:
This was a straightforward factual/educational query with no harm-adjacent or distasteful content involved, so the specialized moderation tuning that distinguishes the two models wasn't a relevant factor. With that dimension neutral, I defaulted to the model with stronger general capability.

Dunlin-235B leads Lapwing-235B across essentially every benchmark — MMLU-Pro (81.2 vs 74.8), GPQA Diamond (64.1 vs 54.3), IFEval (89.8 vs 85.6), Arena-Hard (90.6 vs 81.4) — and on internal routing evals including Summarization (86.4 vs 80.3) and Extraction & Retrieval (85.3 vs 81.6). These gaps are well outside run-to-run variance.

The query also had an explicit instruction-following component ("don't ramble... just explain it"), and Dunlin's higher IFEval score makes it the better fit for honoring that constraint. So Dunlin was the clear pick.
